title: Number of Long-Term Visit Pass Plus Granted after Introduction of Scheme
what_it_is: Number of Long-Term Visit Pass Plus Granted after Introduction of Scheme

sections.label: Foreign spouses granted LTVP and LTVP+
sections.summary: From 1 October 2014 to 31 December 2015, 12,743 foreign spouses received LTVP and 5,879 received LTVP+.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: During the period 1 October 2014 to 31 December 2015, a total of 12,743 foreign spouses were granted LTVP and another 5,879 foreign spouses were granted LTVP+.

sections.label: LTVP and LTVP+ application success rate
sections.summary: Since LTVP+ began on 1 April 2012, an average of 16,738 LTVP/LTVP+ applications were received yearly, about 88% successful.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Since the introduction of LTVP+ on 1 April 2012, an average of 16,738 LTVP/LTVP+ applications have been received annually, of which about 88% were successful.

sections.label: LTVP+ stay, subsidies and employment concessions
sections.summary: Each LTVP+ allows a three-to-five-year stay, PR-like healthcare subsidies, employment concessions with MOM Letters of Consent, and exclusion from the foreign worker quota.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Each LTVP+ allows its holder to stay for three to five years and LTVP+ holders already enjoy healthcare subsidies at a level similar to Permanent Residents (PRs).

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: They also enjoy employment concessions, with Letters of Consent from MOM, and, like PRs, they will not be counted in the foreign worker quota.

sections.label: Stable marriage definition and LTVP process
sections.summary: There are no plans to define a stable marriage; factors include marriage length, the transparency suggestion is taken, and LTVP and LTVP+ use the same process.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: So, I hope to get the Parliamentary Secretary's clarification.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: There are no plans at this stage to define what a stable marriage is.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: One of the factors we look at is the length of years of the marriage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: It is not easy to put out a set of criteria and say "This is the set of the criteria and this is it".

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: But the suggestion is taken; the need for transparency is something we will take very seriously.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: When you apply for an LTVP, as I mentioned during my reply just now, that is the same process for LTVP and LTVP+.
